title: fix(web): keep closed pull requests out of the inbox while it reloads
body:
## What changed

- The inbox rows and both inbox counts stay hidden until GitHub first answers with the open pull requests. Before that, every pull request with a verdict looks open, closed ones included.
- A failed GitHub read counts as an answer, so the inbox falls back to the verdicts it has.
- The inbox loading state and the global loading pulse wait for that same first answer.

## Verification

- `bun run check` and web tests pass.

Closes CL-XXXX
